description: A criminal syndicate that taxes the poor districts.

description: Cyberterrorists who hate implanted people.  Placeholder name.

job_description: I know who needs what done.

dynamic_line.yes: I don't talk to you.  Leave before somebody gets hurt.

no.yes: A stranger.  Buy a drink or move along.
You again.  You keep your head down, which I like.
no.no: Good to see you.  Sit.  What do you need?

responses.text: Where do I stand with you?

dynamic_line.yes: Nothing for strangers.  Do something useful first.

no.yes: I have a few things that need doing.  Pays 1500 yen and a good word.
no.no: You are already carrying a job.  Finish it or drop it first.

responses.text: [Report] I watched the subject, as asked.
[Retrieval] Recover a package and bring it back.
[Removal] Find a target and deal with him.
Drop the job I am carrying.

dynamic_line: Good.  That is how this works.  Your pay is in your hand.

no.yes: Hostile.  Don't push it.
Unfriendly.  I wouldn't trust you with a coat.
Neutral.  You are nobody to me.
Tolerated.  You can trade here.
Friendly.  People here like you.
Trusted.  You're one of ours, almost.
